integrity: New analytic calculations are supplied with a reproducible optional finite verifier; the volume theorem and published numerical covering value are attributed to their sources. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharpness is restricted to the explicit symmetric ten-vertex family. The ten-point numerical covering radius was already tabulated in 1994; a global ten-point covering theorem is not claimed. Historical priority of the complete analytic profile remains provisional. Finite computations do not substitute for the proof.
title: Exact inball phase and all-facet tangency of gyroelongated square bipyramids
